Forms

Input

Text field with label, helper text and error, wired for screen readers. Class contract: .rse-field + .rse-input. Every other prop goes to the <input>; className goes to the field wrapper.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Labeled text field with focus ring, error and helper-text states.

<Input label="Nome completo" placeholder="Digite seu nome" />
<Input label="E-mail" error="E-mail inválido" />

The label, the field and its message are wired for screen readers: the message is the field's aria-describedby, and error sets aria-invalid. Any native attribute (name, autoComplete, inputMode, required…) goes straight to the <input>; ref reaches it too. className styles the wrapper.

<Input label="CPF do responsável" name="cpf" inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="off" required
  error={erroCpf} helpText="Somente números" />

Without React (CMS, portal):

<div class="rse-field rse-field--invalid">
  <label class="rse-field__label" for="cpf">CPF do responsável</label>
  <input class="rse-input" id="cpf" name="cpf" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="cpf-msg">
  <p class="rse-field__message" id="cpf-msg">Informe os 11 dígitos do CPF.</p>
</div>

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
labelstring—
helpTextstring—Helper text below the field (alias: hint)
hintstring—
errorstring—Error message — replaces the helper text, sets aria-invalid and is announced with the field

Also accepts every attribute of React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, a ref and className.

CSS classes

Blocks
.rse-field .rse-input
Elements
.rse-field__label .rse-field__message .rse-field__required
Modifiers
.rse-field--invalid

Component tokens

Set any of these on :root or an ancestor to re-skin Input without touching its CSS. Each defaults to a role token, so it follows the theme. Use a role or palette token as the new value, and keep its pairs in scripts/contrast-pairs.mjs passing.

TokenDefaultLightDarkContrast
--rse-input-bg{rse.color.surface-card}#ffffff#24232f#ffffff
--rse-input-border{rse.color.border-strong}#84806f#7a7890#000000
--rse-input-border-focus{rse.color.primary}#6c62c4#8e82d8#4a3fa8
--rse-input-border-invalid{rse.color.danger}#cc646a#f78f94#a3232b
--rse-input-fg{rse.color.text-heading}#2b2a3d#f4f3ee#000000
--rse-input-radius{rse.radius.md}14px14px14px
